# Dialed by H

> Dialed by H is an independent luxury watch dealer and sourcing service run by Henry Ohler, operating in Boston, New York City and Miami and shipping insured across the US.

Buyers can purchase from live inventory or submit a sourcing request for a specific watch; Henry locates it on their behalf and responds within 12 hours. Every watch is independently authenticated, with fully insured shipping anywhere in the US. Boston clients can meet in person.

## Core Service

- [Home](https://www.dialedbyhenry.com/): Overview of the dealer, sourcing service and current inventory.
- [How It Works](https://www.dialedbyhenry.com/process): Step-by-step explanation of the sourcing and acquisition process.
- [Buy a Watch](https://www.dialedbyhenry.com/buy): Browse watches currently available for direct purchase, filterable by brand and collection.
- [Request to Source](https://www.dialedbyhenry.com/source): Submit a request for a specific reference.
- [About](https://www.dialedbyhenry.com/about): Background on Henry and the business.
